title: UPGRADE Package across a three-repository estate on two versions
why: B0 asks for stable fixture identifiers and expected facts for the first vertical slice. This scenario pins what `UPGRADE Package` must compile to and what its simulation must find, so the deterministic slice has a fixture to regress against rather than only unit assertions.

compile.intent: Upgrade left-pad to 1.3.0 in the estate

refusals.intent: Plant a tree in my garden
refusals.why: §3 requires a request whose predicate and subject are outside the grammar to fail grounding before any simulation

refusals.intent: Upgrade left-pad to 9.9.9 in the estate
refusals.why: a version no registry provider offers is not an immutable target

refusals.intent: Upgrade lef to 1.3.0 in the estate
refusals.why: an inferred subject must never compile silently

expected_findings.why: the two repositories still on 1.2.0 move
the estate's before and after spread is a fact, not an interpretation

simulate.determinism: an identical tenant, estate watermark, ChangeSet, and policy version must produce an identical result hash
